instruction: How to generate TLS authentication key
How to create a OpenVPN server config
output:
echo 'port 1194
proto udp
dev tun
ca /etc/openvpn/ca.crt
cert /etc/openvpn/server.crt
key /etc/openvpn/server.key
dh /etc/openvpn/dh.pem
server 10.8.0.0 255.255.255.0
ifconfig-pool-persist ipp.txt
keepalive 10 120
auth SHA256
cipher AES-256-CBC
user nobody
group nogroup
persist-key
persist-tun
status openvpn-status.log
verb 3' > /etc/openvpn/server.conf

instruction: How to create a OpenVPN client config
output:
echo 'client
dev tun
proto udp
remote 192.168.1.10 1194
resolv-retry infinite
nobind
persist-key
persist-tun
ca ca.crt
cert client1.crt
key client1.key
auth SHA256
cipher AES-256-CBC
verb 3' > /etc/openvpn/client.ovpn
